scope.method: six context-separated OpenAI review passes, three critic passes, one judgment pass, one synthetic executable fixture

verifier.meaning: The synthetic fixture satisfies the current pilot invariants. This does not validate real historical data or complete TLO R2.

candidateR2Patches: Claim or Assertion as a first-class entity
Layer separation among Source Event, Asset, Observation, Claim, Process, World Object and View
Evidence dependency graph and shared error groups
Unknown, Not Observed, Observed Absent and Not Applicable separation
Time-scoped identity relations including successor, reconstruction, split, merge and same-site
Reproducible Current Best View with policy and transaction time
Scale in core and Spectrum as a continuous-field extension
Quantity Kind, Unit, Reference Frame, Measurement Procedure and Uncertainty binding
deferred: final file extension and binary layout
complete rights, privacy and access model
keyFindings: Three files in the fixture resolve to two independent observation roots because two aerial assets share one capture and calibration lineage.
A memory map can retain social-relation claims while its geometric position claim remains in conflict.
A modern same-site building remains a separate World Object.
A declared AI reconstruction is excluded from direct historical evidence.
An unobserved west facade remains Unknown.
Current Best View is derived and reproducible, while evidence and conflicting claims remain append-only.

nextGate.requiredBeforeR2Draft: Run the same pipeline on one small real historical-building evidence set with clear custody and lineage.
